metadata.description: Watchdog: a pack of security dogs for Claude Code. Each dog guards one surface.

plugins.name: watchdog
plugins.description: The pack leader: /go-pack runs every installed dog and merges the findings.

plugins.name: malinois
plugins.description: Malinois — the VAPT dog. Sniffs out vulnerabilities in source code, web apps, APKs and IPAs, then writes the report. Authorized testing only.

plugins.name: husky
plugins.description: Husky — the cloud dog. Sniffs out misconfigurations in Terraform, Kubernetes, Dockerfiles and CI pipelines. Static review only.

plugins.name: collie
plugins.description: Collie — the AI dog. Sniffs out prompt injection, over-powered agent tools, unsafe model output, RAG leaks and risky MCP config. Static review only.

plugins.name: bloodhound
plugins.description: Bloodhound — the API dog. Reads OpenAPI/GraphQL specs and handlers together to sniff out BOLA, broken auth, mass assignment, SSRF and shadow routes. Static review only.

plugins.name: beagle
plugins.description: Beagle — the privacy dog. Sniffs out personal data flowing into logs, analytics, third-party SDKs and storage, and maps findings to GDPR and India's DPDP Act.

plugins.name: rottweiler
plugins.description: Rottweiler — the supply-chain dog. Guards what you pull in: lockfiles, package names, install scripts, pinning, SBOMs, release signing and licences.

plugins.name: doberman
plugins.description: Doberman — the auth dog. Guards the front door: login, OAuth/OIDC, sessions, password reset, MFA, JWTs and SSO.

plugins.name: shepherd
plugins.description: Shepherd — the mobile dog. A deep dive on Android, iOS, Flutter and React Native apps: storage, pinning, deep links, WebViews and native bridges.

plugins.name: dachshund
plugins.description: Dachshund — the database dog. Digs into schemas, migrations, row-level security, database roles and Firebase/Supabase rules.

plugins.name: akita
plugins.description: Akita — the secrets dog. Goes past finding keys: rotation, storage, .env handling, git history cleanup and pre-commit blocking.

plugins.name: pointer
plugins.description: Pointer — the frontend dog. Points at browser-side risk in React, Vue, Angular and plain JS: XSS sinks, CSP, postMessage and token storage.

plugins.name: saintbernard
plugins.description: Saintbernard — the incident-response dog. Comes to the rescue after something went wrong: reads logs, builds a timeline, finds blast radius and writes containment steps.

plugins.name: shiba
plugins.description: Shiba — the Web3 dog. Audits smart contracts in Solidity and Rust: reentrancy, access control, oracle manipulation, arithmetic and upgrade proxies.

plugins.name: pyrenees
plugins.description: Pyrenees — the compliance dog. Maps findings from every Watchdog dog to SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS and OWASP ASVS, and lists the evidence an auditor will ask for.
